propertySets.name: Pset_DistributionChamberElementTypeInspectionChamber
propertySets.definition: Chamber constructed on a drain, sewer or pipeline and with a removable cover, that permits visible inspection.

properties.name: ChamberLengthOrRadius
properties.definition: Length or, in the event of the shape being circular in plan, the radius of the chamber.

properties.name: ChamberWidth
properties.definition: Width, in the event of the shape being non circular in plan.

properties.name: InspectionChamberInvertLevel
properties.definition: Level of the lowest part of the cross section as measured from ground level.

properties.name: SoffitLevel
properties.definition: Level of the highest internal part of the cross section as measured from ground level.

properties.name: WallMaterial
properties.definition:
The material from which the wall of the chamber is constructed.
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: WallThickness
properties.definition:
The thickness of the wall construction.
NOTE: It is assumed that walls will be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: BaseMaterial
properties.definition:
The material from which the base of the chamber is constructed.
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: BaseThickness
properties.definition: The thickness of the base construction, assumed to be constructed at a single thickness.

properties.name: WithBackdrop
properties.definition: Indicates whether the chamber has a backdrop or tumbling bay (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: AccessCoverMaterial
properties.definition:
The material from which the access cover to the chamber is constructed.
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

properties.name: AccessLengthOrRadius
properties.definition: The length of the chamber access cover or, where the plan shape of the cover is circular, the radius.

properties.name: AccessWidth
properties.definition: The width of the chamber access cover where the plan shape of the cover is not circular.

properties.name: AccessCoverLoadRating
properties.definition: The load rating of the access cover (which may be a value or an alphanumerically defined class rating).
